avis.texte: Thought i was going crazy at first, but this made my eyes drier
I thought this eye cream would be a good and affordable alternative. However, it leaves a flaky residue around my eyes, which is a major drawback. I wouldn't buy it again.

The eye cream itself is fine, quite moisturizing. However, after a few months of daily use, the packaging has split open. I have never had this happen with other products. I didn't torture this packaging, just light pressure to dispense the product. Now the product is essentially exposed and subject to contamination, which is no good for eye products.
I really like this eye cream, but I won't buy it again because the tube has split at the seam and at least half the product will be wasted.
Great very hydrating eye cream that is safe for sensitive skin.
Used this once and it gave me a breakout. Never used it again and will not purchase again.

Used this product 1week and I noticed my eyes burning and watering. Very disappointed. Never had an eye cream burn my eyes before and I've used peptide eye cream before. Something in this product is a problem.
I been using this eye cream for 2 months and my crows feet gone! My undereyes feel soo hydrating 10/10

avis.titre: For me, BEST eye cream I've used in a long time!!
avis.texte: I use quite a few of naturiams products at this point! I love their barrier bounce mist, the barrier serum the multi-peptide serum and use their glow getter body wash & body butter, I use their glow milk toner & serum duo and 8 have used their eye illuminating cream-I like it- I used the vit c eye cream-like it- however lately my eye lids and inner corner of my eyes have been looking dry dry dry! Concealer & powder look cracked cake! This eye cream (I bought 2) to try out longevity wise and thus far, 2- 2/12 weeks my eyes are way more soft, velvety and moisturized, I am currently in for the win with this product! I super appreciate Susan Yara for this line of such a dynamic line & array of products a variety at an attainable price point! Ohhh I cannot forget my phyto lip balm & phyto glow lippie. Ohhh I love & have Stardust/Eclipse/& Orbit my new FAV color l
Seems to be working well. Not very moisturizing but I like it
This peptide is helping me tremendously with my eye bags and eye wrinkles.
i have been using this for a couple days but today the skin around my eyes started turninh red and later i started feeling a burning sensation and had slightly bloodshot eyes
I love it! Winters make my shin so dry, this product is great for moisture anytime!

I wanted to love this but unfortunately it caused major burning, sensitivity, redness and even peeling around the outer corners of my eyes. I've had to use aquaphor day and night to heal the damage it did to my skin.
I actually think its a good cream as soon as I put it on, my undereyes feel refreshed it does kind of weird but if doesnt bother me.... I will be buying it again.
Not sure if it's a packaging issue but the product smells like plastic
Love this eye cream. It's rich but soaks in quickly and works really well under makeup.

I am 23 years old and have gone through two of these eyecreams and I am absolutely obsessed. I was looking for a thick non-irritating eye cream as im really into preventing wrinkles, but I have a hard time with some eye creams irritating my eyelid (tip: apply eye cream first). I noticed after two months of consistent use my eyelashes have grown and they're noticeably longer and fuller! This was a pleasant surprise and I wasn't expecting this but now that I have it I can't not use it! I experimented and tried switching to a different eye cream for another month and noticed my lashes revert back to normal shorter lashes, so overall confirmed this does the trick and saved me so much $$$ on lash serums :)
Just received the product and was excited to try it as I love the multi peptide serum. Unfortunately this eye cream seems to irritate my skin and makes my eyes water. Wish it could be returned.
I just began using this eye cream. It's a bit thicker than I'm used to, but it seems to be doing a good job. 4 1/2 stars

avis.titre: My favorite eye cream of all time!
avis.texte: My eyes get dry and irritated easily, but this counteracts that quickly. It leaves the perfect finish—super hydrating, but not overly tacky or oily. It wears well under makeup and I can use it 2x/per day on my entire eye contour with zero irritation. I've seen a marked difference in fine lines as well. I've been through so many tubes. This formula is my ride or die. No other eye cream compares!
This looks great at first when I apply my usual under-eye makeup, but quickly looks dry and creased, unlike my usual eye cream.

This eye cream is hydrating and smooths my fine lines. I've repurchased this 4 times and have recommended it to family and friends. In fact, I enjoy many of the Naturium products - they're A great price point and they are great skincare, face & body, products!

This is cosmetically elegant, but that's where the positive ends. It's a good price, but my normal (ie not dry) under eyes eat this up - and I'm using so much so it's a small tube for how much I end up using - in spite of there not being lasting hydration or moisture.

I went into Ulta for an eye cream to help with circles under my eyes and lines (I'm 62). The first cream I was shown was $100 so I asked for something more economical. Naturium eye cream was then recommended. Great product at a great price!

I am going out of my way to leave this review. Because WOW. I purchased this to just simply have a good eye cream with great ingredients. As I already love this brand. I don't deal with darkness under my eyes nor lines but was just looking forward to having a good eye cream. After about 3/4 weeks I've noticed my under eye skin LITERALLY glowing ! It's so much smoother and BRIGHTER! It seriously looks as if I'm wearing a really white or light concealer under my eyes but I'm not! I seriously love how they look . I had no idea my under eye skin could be any brighter than already. I'm so pleasantly surprised! 10/10

I bought this along with the serum and moisturizer. The others are okay. However, this eye cream makes my skin around my eyes burn so bad. It doesn't last but maybe 5 min. but it's enough for me to discontinue use. I even get a stinging sensation with the moisturizer. The serum is great though!
This is the best eye cream I've tried. Will be purchasing again.
Feels great, so smooth and hydrating! I will be purchasing again.
Ive tried many eye creams and somehow I keep repurchasing this one. It works, its super hydrating and its affordable.
Ive tried many eye creams and somehow I keep repurchasing this one. It works, its super hydrating and its affordable.

I'm always on the hunt for a great eye cream for maturing skin. This product has been such a pleasant surprise! It shouldn't be, because I've yet to meet a Naturium product I haven't loved! The brand somehow provides a very upscale product line at the most reasonable prices. The packaging is perfection! A squeeze tube where I don't need to dip my finger into a pot? Sign me up! It's the perfect consistency and texture - not too thick but thick enough it feels super hydrating going on, and continues to provide moisture throughout the day. I've already purchased a backup - I even have my husband using it!

avis.titre: This should have a higher rating?!
avis.texte: I think this is such smooth velvety eye cream. I am shocked to see if doesnt have 4.5 stars and above! Ive tried a lot of eye creams and this is a great price point for this type of cream with these ingredients

avis.titre: Goodbye fine lines and puffy bags!
avis.texte: I am loving this eye cream! It's very hydrating, but not too thick. My fine lines and wrinkles have massively improved since using this product! It also helps with my morning puffiness. This eye cream's only con is that if you have very dark circles, it doesn't do much for them. I do not tend to have much discoloration underneath my eyes, so this is not an issue for me.

I've become really interested in this brand because they provide affordable skincare with quality ingredients that feel luxurious going onto your skin. The Glow Getter Body Wash is a perfect example - it's a 20/10 for me! I also have some serums I love so decided to try the eye cream. So far, it's great! The tube packaging is something I REALLY appreciate, as I hate dipping my fingers into a jar. The consistency is perfect! Not too liquidy but not too thick. Does a great job of moisturizing the delicate skin underneath my eyes. Even my husband uses it! Gentle on skin, we will see how it hold up to my dry winter skin. So far, it's another win for Naturium!

Love the multipeptide eye cream for my night time eye cream. It's thick, creamy, really moisturizing. Hope it helps with fine lines and texture over time. I prefer the vitamin c eye cream for day. It's still moisturizing but wears better under makeup.

avis.titre: Wanted to like it but it caused a bad reaction
avis.texte: I suspect the ingredients are too harsh for the under-eye area. It cause red bumps and burning irritation within minutes of using. Slightly disappointing
I give it a few stars for the price, however, this eye cream is not moisturizing(I have dry skin). It also doesnt have a good slip or doesnt spread nicely on the skin.

I've been looking for eye cream without silicones at a decent price and haven't had luck until finding this product! Personally, I dislike using creams with silicones because it doesn't feel truly hydrating, just sits on the skin. No silicones and the peptides are rich but not heavy. This didn't irritate my sensitive eyes in the peak of allergy season. Give this a try!

I've been looking for eye cream without silicones at a decent price and haven't had luck until finding this product! Personally, I dislike using creams with silicones because it doesn't feel truly hydrating, just sits on the skin. No silicones and the peptides are rich but not heavy. This didn't irritate my sensitive eyes in the peak of allergy season. Give this a try!
I wanted to like this eyecream so bad but as soon as i put it on I started to feel my skin burning. I dont have sensitive skin so I was so surprised that it cause an exteme burning sensation.
It's a wonderful eye cream. It seems to be extremely hydrating and helps keeps the crows toes away. I'm 45 and genuinely use this eye cream every day.

avis.titre: Just as good as $100+ eye creams!
avis.texte: My absolute favorite eye cream. As someone with incredibly reactive and sensitive skin, finding something that doesnt irritate me AND actually works is so hard. But this eye creams wins out over any others at this price, and I like it just as much as others I've used that are far more expensive.

This is super lightweight but feels buttery and luxurious on the eyes. It doesnt irrite sensitive eyes and it really hydrates and makes concealer look amazing. You only need a small amount. It also is unscented. The packaging is also nice!
Didn't see any changes after 2 months of use. But that doesn't mean it won't work for you.

So hydrating! I'm 27 and starting to notice some fine lines around my eyes. This has helped so much with general hydration, and my fine lines look so much less noticeable. It also sits really nice under concealer/foundation!
Don't think it necessarily is making my skin more plump but definitely a nice and hydrating under eye cream to use at night
Once I started using this product. I instantly saw the the difference

I don't know if was this product or another one from Naturium but I just had the worst allergic reaction on my face. I won't buy again. Naturium is the only brand I'm using right now and my face is just terrible right now.
I have very sensitive eyes. This new eye cream will be a great addition to my skincare routine.
Great eye treatment. I've noticed less eye wrinkles recently.
Love the multi peptides line and this eye cream being one of them. Would have been nice however if I received my multi peptides serum but I never got it However I'm sure it's great.

Feels amazing. I love putting it on after washing off my eye makeup. I have very sensitive eyelids, and get frequent styes. When I first started using this, I was a bit careless with my application and I think it got too close to my lash pores. I did wake up with a stye. This cream feels so good going on and I didn't want to stop using it. I was more conservative with my application and haven't gotten another stye since.

I like it. Seems to hydrate the area well with no migration and it doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes. A good, solid daily part of my routine. Too soon to tell if there will be visible improvement or results, but if it just keeps my aging undereyes soft, doesn't irritate and plays well under makeup, I'll call that a win.
Love this. Moisturizing eye cream in the best container. In this tube form you can't contaminate it as you can a jar. Very soothing and moisturizing. Reasonably priced.
Great moisturizer! Not greasy,great for sensitive skin,great over the serums and love the eye cream too! I have the whole Naturium line and blows the competition away!

avis.titre: Love how soft my under eyes feel!
avis.texte: Love it! Love everything from Naturium! Makes my under eyes so soft!

loving so far. i havent used it long enough to see benefits but i'm loving the texture and how it hydrates my under eyes for concealer. my concealer goes on smooth and doesn't cakes or settle in. another great product !
So far so good! I cant tell a huge difference if my dark circles are less because of this or because of my trentnoin but still love it!
It's just a basic eye cream...which is fine...but it burns my eyes terribly bad.
This eye cream has helped my dark circles under my eyes. They have faded quite a bit. Love it!
I used to have really bad dark circles, but this has brightened them up within four days!
Very hydrating but light and fast absorbing. Love the argireline in it to help with wrinkles.
I really like this! My only complaint is I wish it was a little more hydrating. It does lighten my dark circles and tightens my under eyes.
Too soon to see a difference but the feel is great very moisturizing and softening. No milia

avis.titre: Only Naturium Product that Caused Irritation
avis.texte: I tried out a whole Naturium routine and this is the only product that I literally cannot use. Stings/burns and has even caused a mild rash in the creases of my eyes- I don't even have sensitive skin! Absolutely bizarre and I see others have experienced the same thing.

Love love love. I use this product every evening (and some mornings) on my eyes, smile lines, and lips. It always makes my skin bouncy enough to endure movement. This product is essential in my routine.

avis.titre: I like it but has irritated sensitive skin.
avis.texte: I like it so far, I'm not sure how often you should use it I was using it every day and whenever my skin was irritated it would sort of burn. But skipping it when I'm irritated has made a big difference.
This is a very nourishing eye cream that has not caused any problems to my under eyes.
I can't say I've noticed many changes in my undereye area to be honest, but I will stay consistent with my usage.
Worthless. It does not help with puffiness or dark circles. Def not worth the money.
This eye cream works! I have tried many to no avail. This does what it promises!
I really liked the eye cream, but the tube it's in broke apart and over half of the product is now wasted. I'm super disappointed.
My new favorite eye cream!!! It's gentle and nourishing. Absolute winner
I have very dry under eyes, and this cream has a great texture to smooth it.

avis.titre: Truly the best eye cream-- please make recyclable!
avis.texte: I am obsessed with this eye cream. It's truly the best one out there; just hydrating and occlusive enough without clogging my skin, really nourishing, works great with reusable eye masks and under make up. I am writing a review because I am hoping naturium will see this, I would really love if the packaging could become recyclable in a future iteration. In my mind that's the only down side to this product.

avis.titre: Best product I've used for my eye care
avis.texte: Omg this eye cream is everything it wanted! A little goes a long way, you feel the tingling after application. I feel the product be sucked into my eyelids, crows feet (that I only have a little of), but I see and feel the difference.
The multi peptide eye cream is a wonderfully lightweight product.
Really can't complain, I love this eye cream and I specifically use this in the morning to de puff and have my under eye feeling creamy

This is hands down my favorite eye cream ever. I've never repurchased the same eye cream multiple times until this one! It is perfectly hydrating and works very well under make up - there is absolutely no pilling! It's so refreshing and makes my under eyes look brighter and hydrated!
I stopped using under eye creams until I read the reviews. My journey just began so in a couple months I'll report back.
Creamy delicious consistency. Very hydrating. Impressed by the quality especially for this price point.
I've used a few different eye creams-this one is no biggy. But the price was right. I'd order it again
I had a reaction that caused an abcess to form inside my eye and become very large and very painful. Such a bummer as I was REALLY counting on this to be my "Holy Grail" eye cream.
Omg thiss!!! I use it with my Dieux reusable eye masks and I swear after 15mins I feel the Botox effect. Around my eyes feel so fresh and great!!! Defffffinitely recommending this gem.

I was really excited to try this eye cream, I have tourettes and I was hoping the "Botox effect" would be beneficial to me. I also just want to keep my eye area well moisturized since I tic a lot. Unfortunately, it made my eyes hurt, and they got red and swollen. I was hoping it wasn't the eye cream, but I tested enough to know it is. Not a bad product necessarily I guess it just doesn't work for me

I was excited to try this because I love most other Naturium products I've used and I'm very loyal to the brand. This one burns my eyelids to the point where they keep burning for days after discontinuing use. I don't have sensitive skin, actually the opposite: my skin is very resilient. Instead I've had to use some soothing lotions for days after to stop the irritation. What a shame, I really wanted to love this.

It's a fine eye cream! But I was bummed to not have the option to buy in a jar rather than a tube. I just lived for the feel of the eye cream in the jar, I was obsessed! Now it's just a like any regular eye cream. Just fine, nothing special. Hope you bring the jar back!

I love this eye cream. I've tried many eye creams and a lot of them irritate my sensitive eyes. This is gentle enough that it never irritates my eyes while also being packed with solid ingredients. The texture is rich and luxurious and leaves my eye area smooth, hydrated, and supple. It layers perfectly under makeup. I use it AM/PM. A solid staple in my routine.
